// diagnostic

E0928

A `#Job fn` clashes with a registered Jet command or repeats a job name in one scope

What

A `#Job fn` clashes with a registered Jet command or repeats a job name in one scope

Why

Top-level commands and jobs must have distinct names, and `jet <name>` must select exactly one function

Fix

Rename the job, e.g. `#Job lint_all: fn()`, or give same-named jobs different scopes.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0928: tests/ui/E0928_job_cli_command_clash.stderr.

Error [jet.JobNameConflict]: Job `serve` clashes with the `#CLI` command `serve`
  --> tests/ui/E0928_job_cli_command_clash.jet:14:1
    |
 14 | #Job(.Ship) serve: fn() { print("job serve") }
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^
  --> tests/ui/E0928_job_cli_command_clash.jet:5:31
    |
  5 |     #Doc("Start the service") serve: fn(self) { print("command serve") }
    |                               ^^^^^ the `#CLI` command `serve` is declared here
 Why: `serve` names both a job and a command of this program, so `jet serve` cannot select exactly one function
 Fix: Rename the job or the command; an `.Internal` job never clashes
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0928
